title: Blue Poppies in Swirls
description: An abstract painting featuring large, bold blue circular flower forms with visible brushstrokes and green stems. The vibrant background consists of overlapping swirling patterns in yellow, orange, red, and pink, accented with smaller blue dots and circles.
prompt: Abstract painting with large expressive blue circular flowers and green stems, set against a dynamic background of swirling yellow, orange, red and pink brushstrokes. Bold visible impasto texture, smaller blue dots and circles scattered throughout the composition, vibrant and energetic color palette with strong contrast between the deep blue floral forms and the warm background swirls.
